notes: Scraped from Iceland's Algolia search API (FRZRDY category = Frozen Ready Meals). 288 raw products fetched across 10 pages. Excluded: sides/sauces (egg fried rice, pilau rice, curry sauce, gravy pots, etc.), large family packs (>=800g), snacks (nuggets, bites, tenders, toasties, crispy pancakes), party food/sharing packs, dim sum multi-piece sets. 257 single-serve complete frozen meals included. Nutrition: where 'Per Pack' column present in API data it is used directly; otherwise calculated from per-100g * pack weight extracted from product name. Deals reflect active promotions at scrape time (e.g. '3 for £6', '5 for £5'). 3 products had non-standard nutrition formats and were manually corrected: Mr Brain's Faggots (per pack from heading), Myprotein Chicken Tikka Wrap (per wrap column), Hall's Haggis (per-100g * 400g). Post-filtering also removed: bulk kebab meats (not complete meals), noodle-coated chicken chunks (chicken pieces without sides), crispy pancake multipacks.
